name: dev.postbag/mcp
description: Postbag — a form backend that routes. One MCP tool per API operation, plus quickstart and explain, so an agent holding only an API key can create and manage forms, streams, destinations, routes and deliveries.

environmentVariables.name: POSTBAG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A Postbag API key (pb_live_… or pb_test_…). Mint one at https://postbag.dev/app or with `postbag login`.

environmentVariables.name: POSTBAG_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Postbag API. Defaults to https://postbag.dev — set this only for a self-hosted instance.
